new_value: Refuse to start unless apiUrl and (expanded) eventSourceUrl are https:// (RFC 8620 §1.7). No same-origin check: RFC 8620 §2 allows URLs elsewhere; --cert pinning bounds hosts. kith-tui does not use download/upload URLs. testjig now needs a URL-rewriting proxy or https URLs.
